name: Slider
title: Slider
description: Precision spring-physics slider and range component with rubber-band resistance, release inertia, odometer rolling numbers, and floating tooltips.
summary: An ultra-smooth, physics-driven slider and range component with 1:1 pointer tracking, iOS-style rubber band resistance past limits, release momentum projection onto the step grid, rolling digit odometer wheels with motion blur, catch-up spring seek on track clicks, and tactile kick springs.
highlights: Ultra-responsive 1:1 pointer tracking with zero lag and sub-pixel spring settling
iOS-style rubber-band resistance beyond boundaries and between dual range thumbs
Deceleration velocity projection on pointer release with smooth snap-to-grid settlement
Rolling number odometer with spring-driven digit columns, direction awareness, and motion blur
Floating value bubble shown while dragging, on keyboard focus, and for 700ms after release
Catch-up spring physics on track press that glides the thumb smoothly to finger without jumps
Boundary kick bounce animation on keyboard limit hit
Full dual-thumb range support with minimum step distance enforcement
Tick dots and mouse-clickable mark labels with edge alignment
Pure Tailwind CSS styling without external CSS module dependencies
anatomy: <div className="relative flex flex-col gap-2 w-full"> (Root container)
<div className="flex items-center justify-between"> (Header with label and RollingNumber readout)
<div className="relative flex items-center w-full h-9 py-2 touch-none cursor-pointer"> (Pointer-capture interactive track area)
<div className="relative w-full h-1.5 rounded-full bg-zinc-800"> (Background track with tick dots)
<motion.div className="absolute inset-0 bg-zinc-400"> (Active progress fill clipped to thumb bounds)
<Thumb> (White circular thumb pill with spring-driven scale, shadow, and floating bubble tooltip)

physics.engine: Time-derived Harmonic Damped Springs with Inertial Deceleration
physics.description: Custom analytical spring integration converting visual duration and bounce into exact stiffness and damping ratios, coupled with asymptotic rubber-banding and release velocity projection.

accessibility.aria: ARIA slider semantics with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuetext, and focus-visible indicators.
accessibility.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion, thumb springs, rubber-banding, edge kicks and digit rolls are skipped. The bubble fades in over 150ms with no blur.

keyboard.description: Jump to minimum or maximum bound.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible and visible label for the slider.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value for single thumb or two-thumb range.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every value change while dragging or using the keyboard.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Called when the user finishes a change (pointer release or key press).

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value boundary.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value boundary.

props.name: step
props.description: Snap step increment.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: Step used by Page Up and Page Down.

props.name: marks
props.description: Ticks and interactive labels along the track.

props.name: minStepsBetweenThumbs
props.description: Minimum distance in steps between the two thumbs of a range slider.

props.name: format
props.description: Custom number formatting function for readout and bubbles.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the formatted value readout.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible names for the two thumbs of a range slider. Defaults to "<label>, minimum" and "<label>, maximum".

props.name: start
props.description: Slot for start icon or controls (e.g. volume mute button).

props.name: end
props.description: Slot for end controls.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper or subtitle text placed below the track.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. Renders hidden inputs so the value is submitted with a form.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction and dims the slider.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
